capabilities: Export a note to a .docx file
Convert math to native Word equations
Render citations with CSL styles and a bibliography
Convert callouts, embeds and Dataview results
Apply a custom Word template and merge notes (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a general document conversion suite; it only exports notes to .docx and does not import Word files.
extras: Free features work offline; Pro is a one-time US$19 license via Polar, limited to 5 devices, not sold in Japan, with a 14-day refund. Pro checks the license online at most once a day and works offline up to 7 days. Web images are fetched from their servers at export time; a region-check request to formchime.com runs when opening settings without a Pro key. Equations target Microsoft Word, so LibreOffice rendering can differ. DataviewJS and inline Dataview queries cannot be exported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce Word documents, and Pandoc-based export requires external installs and loses formatting like equations and callouts.

relations.evidence: Export Obsidian notes to clean, editable Word (.docx) files. No Pandoc, no extra installs
a .bib or CSL JSON file (for example exported from Zotero)

summary: Exporter that converts Obsidian notes to editable .docx files without Pandoc, preserving equations, citations, callouts, embeds and tables.
